title: Micron vs SanDisk: Which Chipmaker Stands Out After the Pullback

content_html:
The AI boom is transforming the memory industry into one of the fastest-growing segments of the semiconductor sector.

Demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and conventional DRAM, along with NAND chips used in AI servers has skyrocketed and pushed memory prices sharply higher. Market intelligence provider TrendForce estimates that conventional DRAM contract prices climbed roughly 93%–98% in Q1 2026 and projects a 58%–63% increase in Q2. NAND flash prices are also expected to remain strong.

The price surges come as the global memory supply struggles to keep pace with demand. Some industry experts expect the memory shortage to last beyond 2030.

Source: Micron Technology

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) and SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) have emerged as two of the biggest beneficiaries of the memory shortage.

Micron and SanDisk Are Locking in Long-Term Supply Agreements

The memory market is notorious for its boom-and-bust cycles. In a bid to shield against the industry's demand cycles and make future revenue more predictable, Micron and SanDisk are positioning their businesses around long-term supply agreements.

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) recently disclosed that it has signed 16 strategic customer agreements to lock in demand. With these deals, Micron's remaining performance obligations jumped sharply from roughly $5 billion at the end of May to around $100 billion after including agreements signed following the quarter's close.

SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) is also pursuing the same strategy in the NAND flash memory market. The company has signed five multi-year supply agreements, including three contracts with minimum revenue commitments totaling $42 billion. These agreements are intended to stabilize pricing and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

How Micron Compares With SanDisk in Business Model and Stock Valuation

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) and SanDisk are both benefiting from the memory industry tailwinds, but their business models are positioned differently.

Micron has broader exposure across DRAM, NAND, and HBM markets. HBM has become one of the fastest-growing segments of the memory industry amid the AI infrastructure buildout. Micron has already sold out its HBM production for 2026. SanDisk, meanwhile, is primarily focused on NAND flash and enterprise storage markets.

In terms of valuation multiples, Micron trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 5.95x, compared with 6.97x for SanDisk. Both memory stocks trade well below the S&P 500's forward PE ratio of roughly 21%.

content_html_zh:
人工智能的繁荣正在将内存行业转变为半导体行业增长最快的领域之一。

对高带宽内存 (HBM) 和传统 DRAM 以及人工智能服务器中使用的 NAND 芯片的需求猛增，导致内存价格大幅上涨。 市场情报提供商 TrendForce 估计，传统 DRAM 合约价格在 2026 年第一季度上涨约 93%–98%，并预计第二季度将上涨 58%–63%。 NAND闪存价格预计也将保持坚挺。

由于全球内存供应难以跟上需求，价格飙升。 一些行业专家预计内存短缺将持续到 2030 年之后。

来源：美光科技

美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）和闪迪公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）已成为内存短缺的两个最大受益者。

美光和 SanDisk 签订长期供应协议

内存市场因其繁荣与萧条周期而臭名昭著。 为了抵御行业需求周期的影响并使未来收入更加可预测，美光和闪迪正在围绕长期供应协议来定位其业务。

美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）最近披露，该公司已签署 16 份战略客户协议以锁定需求。 通过这些交易，美光科技的剩余履约义务从 5 月底的约 50 亿美元大幅跃升至约 1000 亿美元（包括本季度结束后签署的协议）。

SanDisk 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）也在 NAND 闪存市场推行同样的战略。 该公司已签署了五份多年供应协议，其中三份合同的最低收入承诺总额为 420 亿美元。 这些协议旨在稳定价格并加强长期客户关系。

美光科技与闪迪在商业模式和股票估值方面的比较

美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）和闪迪都受益于内存行业的顺风车，但他们的商业模式定位不同。

美光在 DRAM、NAND 和 HBM 市场拥有更广泛的业务。 随着人工智能基础设施的建设，HBM 已成为存储器行业增长最快的领域之一。 美光已售完 2026 年的 HBM 产量。 与此同时，SanDisk 主要专注于 NAND 闪存和企业存储市场。

就估值倍数而言，美光的预期市盈率为 5.95 倍，而闪迪的预期市盈率为 6.97 倍。 两只内存股的交易价格均远低于标准普尔 500 指数约 21% 的远期市盈率。
